# BRIEF UPDATE
We closed another successful week in the development of Osprey today. 

First of all, Our marketing pilot has been set to begin in anticipation for our upcoming launch. On that note, we are happy to announce that we are targeting Saturday, December 5th, For the launch of Osprey!

Secondly, We have updated our [website](https://osprey.build) with a new landing page, making it more accessible to new players. Our full website is still reachable via a button in the website footer.

Finally, We have obtained the discord.gg/osprey vanity link. Feel free to share this with your friends!

Thank you for supporting Osprey!

news.author: Osprey
news.content:
@everyone
# UPDATE 4
**Thank you participating in our showcase yesterday!** Taking note of your feedback, Our team has decided to begin enacting a few changes in Osprey's upcoming launch.

## I) THE WARDEN
The warden will be buffed ensuring you have confidence in your builds protection.

## II) CHANGES IN MOBS
Mobs will be able to be **retracted back into their egg form**, maintaining all of their data, in order to allow them to be moved, stored, or traded.

## III) FEATHER AND BANISHMENT
For our banishment mechanic, players drop their feather. Beforehand, The timer on their feather could **run out naturally** or be **fuelled** to last longer. 

Now, Players on "the outside" Will be able to bail you out of banishment by **paying off your feather with vigil**, The reverse action of fuelling it.

## IV) TRADE RARITY
Villagers will have **rarer trades** for highly sought-after enchants and items to ensure a healthy server economy.

## V) THE CRYSTAL
An **e-chest** will be added to your crystal to increase functionality.

# WHO ARE WE?
This is a question we have recieved a lot, So the team has decided to clarify here, once, to lay the question to rest.

Osprey was founded in 2020 by Caoimhín. He ultimately remains the owner. Ospreys team, including caoimhín, hyun, and a vast array of those who have helped over the years, all remain.

Day to day operations of the server though have been handed off to Us, The new organization, pseudonimously known simply as Osprey. 

The former osprey team have input on how the overall vision plays out, to ensure it aligns with their plans. The vision of Osprey, the pillars it stands on, The mechanics and the gameplay are all guided by the former team who maintain oversight albeit without direct control or power as conceded in our strategic agreement.
